command.pay.description:
Send money from your wallet to another player.

Usage: player_pay <player name> <amount>

The last argument is the amount, so names with spaces work: player_pay Maria Clara 5000
Run player_list to see the exact names. Only works on saves with separate wallets.
command.list.description: List the online players and their exact names, to use with player_pay.
